label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (insecure-randomness) is TP: java.util.Random.nextInt() feeds rememberMeKey used for session persistence (cookie/session attribute) without cryptographic PRNG. Alert 2 (xss) is TP: user-provided cookie value flows to HTML output via response.getWriter().println() - the 'whose value is:' section displays rememberMe.getValue() which may contain user-supplied data.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness: new java.util.Random().nextInt(99) assigned to rememberMeKey used for remember-me token
XSS sink: response.getWriter().println() outputs user+rememberMe.getName()+rememberMe.getValue() - user input from cookie can reach HTML
